Phase 2 of the matched-clients plan. Build the TS/bun client in this repo as the full peer of python/openbrain-memory, implemented against the shared contract fixtures (see the contract-parity harness issue; that gate must land first and this client must pass the identical fixture set to ship).

Scope: direct HTTP client (bearer auth, exact-scope session proof per #294), JSONL spool with the same caps/backpressure/redaction semantics (#300/#304), auto-drain (#307, including the scope-aware handling tracked in #310), receipts with bounded error categories (#308), session lifecycle (session_start/capture/checkpoint/wrap/recall), contract id + schema-hash declaration on the wire.

Non-goals: no change to the Python client; no adapter cutover in this issue (Development-side follow-up); no server changes beyond what the parity tripwire needs.

Measured motivation: the current Claude path spawns a Python child per hook event (~55-80ms before any I/O); a bun-native client fetch round trip to core01 measures ~33ms total. The TS client removes the entire artifact-management class (venv/wheel/pinning) from the TS runtime path.
